changelog:
Version 1.0.7: ✨ Added
- Custom novel tags with create, edit, delete, and default-tag support.
- Novel version selector and version-specific data management.
- Home page sorting by Title, Last Modification, and Date of Insertion.
- Large-cover and small-cover/title display modes.
- Improved ZIP backup and import support.
- Smart matching of imported novels with existing titles and versions.
- Automatic 🔞 Adult tag detection and (A) reference-prefix handling.
- Compact About the Developer section with social links.
- Backup and restore compatibility.
- ZIP export/import structure.
- Novel version migration and duplicate detection.
- Settings page design and overall UI consistency.
Abu Bokker (axon469).
